biocontainers.name: bioconductor-methrix
biocontainers.summary: Fast and efficient summarization of generic bedgraph files from bisufite sequencing

biotools.summary: Bedgraph files generated by Bisulfite pipelines often come in various flavors. Critical downstream step requires summarization of these files into methylation/coverage matrices. This step of data aggregation is done by Methrix, including many other useful downstream functions.
